Step into a dark and glamorous Bollywood Halloween night at Bhootiful—a thrilling costume party filled with music & mystery

About this Event

🩸 BLOOTIFUL — Halloween Bollywood Costume Party 🩸Get ready for a night of dark glamour, Bollywood beats, and Halloween madness! 🖤🔥
Alpha Colors presents BLOOTIFUL, an unforgettable Halloween Bollywood costume party at Myth Lounge, San Jose. 
Dress to impress—or terrify! 👻 Come in your most creative Halloween costume and step into a night filled with spooky vibes, high-energy Bollywood music, and a hauntingly beautiful atmosphere.

🎁 Amazon Gift Card for best Costume
📅 Friday, October 30th
📍 Myth Lounge, San Jose
👻 Halloween Bollywood Costume Party
Expect Bollywood • Punjabi • Desi Hits • Party Anthems all night long!
🩸 Costumes encouraged. Come dressed for the BLOOTIFUL!
Gather your crew, bring your best Halloween look, and get ready to dance the night away.
Tickets are limited — grab yours before they disappear! 🎃🩸
